subject.title: fix: allow bailian provider in resolveThinkingProfile

question: Should configured custom `bailian` providers infer Qwen thinking support from `compat.thinkingFormat` by default, or should official reasoning support remain only in Qwen-owned provider/catalog paths?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but enabling reasoning from compat metadata changes existing custom-provider behavior and overlaps a broader provider-owned Coding Plan support decision.

options.title: Accept Narrow Custom-Provider Inference After Cleanup
options.body: Allow the generic configured-model paths to treat `bailian` like `vllm` for Qwen compat after the vLLM hook is removed and real Bailian proof matches the changed path.

options.title: Keep Support Provider-Owned
options.body: Reject the custom-provider inference and route Bailian/Coding Plan reasoning through Qwen-owned catalog/provider work only.

options.title: Defer Until Vendor-Proven Model Matrix
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers have current model- and region-specific Alibaba proof for the intended support boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Custom-Provider Inference After Cleanup
recommendation.body: Allow the generic configured-model paths to treat `bailian` like `vllm` for Qwen compat after the vLLM hook is removed and real Bailian proof matches the changed path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the Qwen provider surface and has already routed the broader Bailian/Coding Plan support-boundary discussion.
